name: seichi-junrei
description: Build evidence-based illustrated travel pilgrimages with user-selected anime, manga and film themes using native Codex art tools.

interface.shortDescription: Find story connections for travel and build a mobile guide.
interface.longDescription: Find 3–5 verified story candidates for a trip; stop for user choice; use native ImageGen when available to create original scene art, then produce a share-safe offline mobile HTML. No external image API; publishing optional.
defaultPrompt: $seichi-junrei:seichi-junrei 次の旅行の聖地巡礼候補を3〜5本提示して。主役を選んだら、利用可能なImageGenで挿絵を作りスマホ用旅のしおりを制作して。
